zh: 三数之和能被 d 整除只与三个价格各自对 d 的余数有关；n 只有 1000，O(n²) 的做法就足够，关键是把第三个下标的枚举换成一次查表。
固定 i 和 j 后，第三个数需要的余数是唯一确定的：(−a[i]−a[j]) mod d。只要知道 j 右侧每种余数出现了多少次，就能一次性加上所有合法的 k。
枚举 i：先把 i 右侧所有价格的余数计入频次表；然后让 j 从 i+1 往右走，每走到一个 j 先把它自己从频次表中移除，再把所需余数的出现次数加进答案；答案用 64 位整数。
en: Whether the sum of three prices is divisible by d depends only on each price modulo d. With n at most 1000, an O(n^2) method is enough; the key is to replace the loop over the third index with a single table lookup.

Once i and j are fixed, the residue the third price needs is uniquely determined: (-a[i]-a[j]) mod d. If you know how many times each residue occurs to the right of j, you can add all valid k at once.

Loop over i: first add the residues of every price to the right of i into a frequency table. Then move j from i+1 to the right; at each j, first remove j itself from the table, then add the count of the required residue to the answer. Keep the answer in a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Fix i and build the frequencies of the residues modulo d of the prices to its right. While iterating over j, first remove j, then look up the count of the required residue `(-a[i]-a[j]) mod d`; that count is the contribution of all k>j.

## Proof of correctness

After j is removed, the frequency table contains exactly the indices k>j. The residue condition is equivalent to the sum of the three numbers being divisible by d. Each i<j<k corresponds to exactly one lookup, so the count has no omissions and no duplicates.

## Complexity

Time O(n^2), space O(n).
